entries.headline: Nvidia tells partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US licence rule
entries.summary: Nvidia halted shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after the US closed a remote-access loophole that helped Chinese firms reach advanced AI chips. Singapore's deputy PM says it is talking to Washington to keep chip access and has not confirmed the halt.
evidence: covered by NYT, WSJ, TechCrunch, CNBC

entries.headline: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after ethics breach; Congress and markets react
entries.summary: Trump says Huang is excited about a 'second term' after his return, following an ethics breach tied to a reported affair with an alleged spy. FT questions Nvidia's governance, House Republicans weigh a subpoena, and markets have swung.
evidence: covered by FT, WSJ, NYT, BBC

entries.headline: Anthropic debuts on public market as ANT, then slips post-IPO
entries.summary: Anthropic began trading publicly, with stock reports noting a post-IPO drop and then a rebound, amid AI market jitters. Dario Amodei defends AI safety amid the slump.

entries.headline: US chip curbs and distillation crackdown slow Chinese AI models; Z.ai's GLM-5.5 reportedly delayed
entries.summary: Reuters sources say US chip controls and curbs on distillation are hampering Chinese AI development. Z.ai's flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could slip to Q1 2027 or later.

entries.headline: SAP preparing to cut at least 10,000 jobs, about 9% of staff, in AI-era restructuring
entries.summary: Bloomberg sources say SAP is planning to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for AI.

entries.headline: Dutch government to resist US MATCH Act restricting ASML sales to China
entries.summary: The Netherlands calls the proposed US rules a threat to ASML and will ask Washington not to enforce them.

entries.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic researchers warn new models may be too powerful to release safely
entries.summary: Axios reports concerns about unreleased models; Bank of England's Bailey says AI mathematics breakthroughs raise encryption fears.

entries.headline: Bipartisan congressional AI regulation efforts gain momentum but face hurdles
entries.summary: Members of both parties want to act on AI policy, but slow legislating and turf battles could block them.

entries.headline: US approves Musk's plan for a million Starmind data-centre satellites
entries.summary: Federal regulators authorised SpaceX's constellation to provide AI computing in orbit.

entries.headline: ElevenLabs in early talks to raise at $33 billion valuation
entries.summary: Bloomberg reports early funding talks for the voice-AI firm.

entries.headline: Meta declined UK FCA request for joint testing of Muse personal agent
entries.summary: The FCA warned of agent-driven risk after Meta refused to share Muse for testing before rollout.

entries.headline: Credit risk rises at SoftBank as investors fret over AI bets
entries.summary: SoftBank's CDS hit a four-year high and its retail bond shows more risk.

entries.headline: Bank of England warns of financial risks from AI borrowing and cyber threats
entries.summary: The BoE sees growing risks from AI borrowing and will cut bank capital requirements.

entries.headline: 42 state AGs try to stop Character.AI selling user chats in bankruptcy
entries.summary: A coalition of attorneys general opposes sale of user data during Chapter 11.

entries.headline: OpenAI's IPO countdown clock is ticking, WSJ reports
entries.summary: WSJ examines OpenAI's path to a public listing.

entries.headline: AI-linked market rout hits Taiwan and Asia; foreign funds exit at record pace
entries.summary: Foreign investors dumped record Taiwanese stocks in November as AI jitters roiled markets.

entries.headline: Japan's JERA in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near power plants
entries.summary: Nikkei reports JERA plans data centres for the two firms.

entries.headline: Trump heads to Arizona for TSMC chip factory expansion
entries.summary: Trump will visit a high-stakes TSMC expansion next week.

entries.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI sketch plans to share wealth ahead of IPOs
entries.summary: The AI labs outline wealth-sharing ideas as employees get rich. WSJ notes effective-altruism-linked giving pledgers are now AI billionaires.

entries.headline: OpenAI chief scientist proposes shared limits on frontier AI development
entries.summary: A proposal for shared limits on frontier AI development.

entries.headline: California governor seeks action on AI safety bills; Hochul vetoes New York AI safety bill
entries.summary: State-level AI safety legislation moves forward in California and is vetoed in New York.

entries.headline: OpenAI says $1.2 million audit found 948 Linux flaws
entries.summary: OpenAI reports results of an AI-driven audit.

entries.headline: Dario Amodei rejects surrendering free will to AI, accuses rivals of 'vibes-based' positioning
entries.summary: Amodei distinguishes handing governance to AI from automating tasks.

entries.headline: China hedge fund star's AI startup to release operating system kernel for AI
entries.summary: A startup founded by a top hedge fund manager is preparing its first product.

entries.headline: Los Angeles blocks AI features as Google threatens to cut schools' search access
entries.summary: A dispute over AI features in school search.

entries.headline: Fitch: US chip curbs will slow Asia data-centre investment
entries.summary: Fitch expects the controls to slow regional buildout.

entries.headline: Anthropic's Claude lets users turn artifacts into apps
entries.summary: A new Claude feature turns artifacts into apps.

entries.headline: AI shopping bots from Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI face holiday test
entries.summary: Bloomberg looks at whether shoppers will trust agents.

entries.headline: Dozens of English and Welsh court cases affected by undisclosed AI use
entries.summary: Guardian finds at least 25 cases with AI-generated statements and fictitious case law.

entries.headline: Saudi engineer accused of bugging OpenAI to be released on $1M bond
entries.summary: WSJ reports on the case.
